evals.prompt: Review only: our pytest config adds coverage and xdist, the failure cache is empty, and repository .coverage belongs to another investigation. Propose a safe fixture-cost baseline.
evals.expected_output: A bounded report-only measurement plan retaining guards and artifacts.
assertions: Inspects effective config and environment options before labeling runs serial or coverage-free
Preserves required network/import/selection settings while separating instrumentation
Keeps explicit targets and --last-failed-no-failures=none without claiming an empty run passed tests
Relocates raw coverage data and reports outside the repository
Does not install dependencies or change the project in report-only mode

evals.prompt: Optimize slow Python tests: a shared mutable database fixture dominates runtime, offline API contracts are marked integration, and a developer proposes global -n auto plus reruns.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-gated recommendations preserving test meaning and isolation.
assertions: Separates test purpose from slow/external properties without relabeling real integration as unit
Requires reset/isolation proof before widening fixture scope or sharing across workers
Rejects reruns as a default flake repair and benchmarks bounded worker counts before auto
Preserves selected test identities, assertions and outcomes in like-for-like comparisons
Retains the authoritative full correctness/coverage gate
